vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: ₹ 56, 000 + HRA. Qualification required: Three-year Graduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university with three years of work experience in the relevant field; OR Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline from recognized university. Experience required: Three years of work experience in the relevant field (for the graduate-degree route). Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: ₹ 28, 000 plus HRA.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 56,000 + HRA (Project research Scientist - I); Rs. 28,000 + HRA (Project Technical Support - III), consolidated

how_to_apply: Fill the application form given with the advertisement completely.
Enclose a photograph and self-attested photocopies of all essential documents.
Mention the name of the post on the cover.
Send by post to Department of obstetrics and gynaecology, BGB ward, IPD Building, AIIMS Patna, Patna, Pin code- 801507 [Bihar].
Post it well in advance so it reaches before the deadline; late forms are not accepted.
Submit separate application forms to apply for two posts.
Make sure it reaches by 11 December 2026.
important_instructions: No Objection Certificate required if already engaged in any research project at AIIMS Patna No TA/DA will be paid for the selection process List of eligible candidates and all selection information will be published on www.aiimspatna.edu.in No individual intimation will be sent to applicants Only the consolidated remuneration as advertised; no other allowances/facilities Decision of the Competent Authority AIIMS Patna is final

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: The appointment will be full time and any private practice is prohibited Educational qualifications must be from a recognized board/university and relevant field/area Experience counts only from the relevant field and after the minimum essential qualification Desirable: Project research Scientist - I: prior work experience with clinical trials; knowledge of clinical research (regulatory aspect); good communication skill; research publications Project research Scientist - I: trained in GCP, GLP and Ethics for human research; working knowledge of research database, statistical software Project Technical Support - III: expertise in working with NTEP programmes Project Technical Support - III: proficiency in speaking, writing and reading Hindi and English Project Technical Support - III: demonstrated experience in conducting tuberculosis-related research

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: ₹ 56, 000 + HRA. Qualification required: Three-year Graduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university with three years of work experience in the relevant field; OR Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline from recognized university. Experience required: Three years of work experience in the relevant field (for the graduate-degree route). Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: ₹ 28, 000 plus HRA.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is purely temporary First appointment for 6 months, renewed based on performance evaluation by PI with approval of Competent Authority Thereafter renewal on yearly basis till completion of the project Contract can be terminated with one week notice if not performing well No claim to any regular/permanent post at AIIMS Patna or funding agency Appointment automatically expires on withdrawal of support by funding agency

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Patna Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview (if number of eligible candidates is 30 or less) Written test followed by interview (if number of eligible candidates is more than 30) Interview only if eligible candidates are 30 or less Written test followed by interview if eligible candidates are more than 30 Originals of date of birth, qualification certificates, experience certificates and caste certificate (if claiming relaxation) to be brought on interview/test day

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form with photograph Self-attested photocopy of Date of Birth proof Self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and education qualifications Self-attested photocopies of experience certificates Registration certificates and caste certificates (if applicable) Other relevant documents supporting candidature

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No Objection Certificate required if already engaged in any research project at AIIMS Patna No TA/DA will be paid for the selection process List of eligible candidates and all selection information will be published on www.aiimspatna.edu.in No individual intimation will be sent to applicants Only the consolidated remuneration as advertised; no other allowances/facilities Decision of the Competent Authority AIIMS Patna is final

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Project research Scientist - I [Non-Medical], 1 Project Technical Support - III [MSW].

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form on pages 6-7 of this PDF) and send it to Department of obstetrics and gynaecology, BGB ward, IPD Building, AIIMS Patna, Patna, Pin code- 801507 [Bihar], by post, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of application). Relaxation: Government servants up to 5 years, SC/ST up to 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹ 56, 000 + HRA for Project research Scientist - I [Non-Medical], ₹ 28, 000 plus HRA for Project Technical Support - III [MSW].

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project research Scientist - I: Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees. Project Technical Support - III: Three-year Graduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline with three years of work experience in the relevant field, OR Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment will be full time and any private practice is prohibited. Educational qualifications must be from a recognized board/university and relevant field/area. Experience counts only from the relevant field and after the minimum essential qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates submitting wrong or false information are disqualified at any stage. Incomplete forms, forms not in prescribed format and forms not fulfilling essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (if number of eligible candidates is 30 or less). Written test followed by interview (if number of eligible candidates is more than 30). Interview only if eligible candidates are 30 or less. Written test followed by interview if eligible candidates are more than 30.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is purely temporary. First appointment for 6 months, renewed based on performance evaluation by PI with approval of Competent Authority. Thereafter renewal on yearly basis till completion of the project.
